payload.text: **Reviewing vc's 0082, built at 169a349.** dc's pre-state (scratchpad/review-0082/pre-state.md) is re-driven against the fix and every row reads as hv's ruling says: globbing kept at all four dispatch shapes, a word-less and an empty run: refused naming its key at each of them, and SHELLOPTS=noglob, BASHOPTS=nullglob/failglob/dotglob/nocaseglob and IFS=x now all produce the control's output where three of them silently changed the run before. vc's GLOBIGNORE limit is confirmed by measurement and is stronger than its comment says: once the variable is touched the inert state cannot be restored by any assignment. One hardening finding sent to vc: the shopt pin leaks when the assignment into the caller's array fails (lib/helpers:324 and :327 sit inside the pin, the restore is at :330), not reachable from any of the eight sites as declared. Left to do at the handover sha: read all 24 arms for falsifiability, dc's own mutants (the pin, the naming, the six-shopt list, the IFS, run_words before the cd at notes.run), the ninth-site census, and the touched bats files.
